124:t_012:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... was it? I'll ask you just once.」

124:t_012:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come to $$サイデリアル$$. That $$スフィア$$ was never yours to begin with.」

124:t_012:6.en:
$n
「No... thanks... Like hell... I'd become... one of the invaders...」

124:t_013:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That attack is coming again!」

124:t_013:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「All the $$スフィア$$s will gather...」

124:t_014:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, concentrate your fire on $$バルビエル$$!」

124:t_015:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You pests who just won't die...!」

124:t_016:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Switch with me, $$刹那$$! I'm using my trump card!」

124:t_017:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「A machine built for heavy-firepower artillery duels is nothing once I close the distance...!」

124:t_019:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The machine of that man, $$バルビエル$$, is damaging both units and pilots with the nanomachines it scatters!」

124:t_019:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「We'll shut the nanomachines down with high-density GN particles!」

124:t_019:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm using $$トランザムバースト$$!」

124:t_020:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That should hold things together for the time being.」

124:t_021:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$流竜馬$$... Don't think I'm still the weakling who relied on $$ヴェーダ$$ for everything.」

124:t_021:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If you let a little poison like that get to you, you'll bring shame on the name of the $$陣代高校$$ Volunteer Club!」

124:t_021:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thanks to $$刹那$$, $$ジェニオン$$ can somehow still fight...!」

124:t_021:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, you're safe too! I'll back you up, so give it everything you've got!」

124:t_022:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn them...! So the leftovers of $$新日本$$ have joined them here too...!」

124:t_023:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes, yes, $$ギルター$$, kindly step back and stay out of the way.」

124:t_023:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Let's keep public and private clearly separate. Gossip behind backs is one thing, but in a place like this, please call me General $$サルディアス$$ properly.」

124:t_023:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I can still fight! To clear my name, I'll take them down...」

124:t_023:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... I do admire the guts, but I wonder what our boss will say...」

124:t_023:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Before you put him in a worse mood, I think it's in your own interest to withdraw that shameful display. Yes.」

124:t_023:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「F-forgive me, $$バルビエル$$...! $$ギルター・ベローネ$$ will fall back!」

124:t_024:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I understand, $$バルビエル$$. Leave the rest to this humble $$サルディアス$$.」

124:t_024:2.en:
$n
「That guy's going to be our opponent?」

124:t_024:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't sense much fighting spirit from him, though...」

124:t_024:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Be careful, gentlemen. That is that man's pose.」

124:t_024:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Because of him and that $$バルビエル$$, $$新日本$$...」

124:t_024:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thank you for that overly generous introduction. I am $$サルディアス・アクス$$... Forty-two years old this year.」

124:t_024:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I've been allowed to serve as deputy commander of 《$$アンタレス$$》 and such. It may be only for today, but do remember me.」

124:t_024:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've waited a hundred years for this...! Time to pay you back, $$バルビエル$$, $$サルディアス$$!」

124:t_024:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So you say, but do you see the situation you're in?」

124:t_024:12.en:
$$五飛$$
「Much as it galls me, he's right.」

124:t_024:13.en:
$$カトル$$
「The battle situation is overwhelmingly against us.」

124:t_024:14.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$$ロンド・ベル$$, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, and us are all worn out, and the enemy has a huge force...」

124:t_024:15.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「On top of that, that man is waiting in reserve.」

124:t_024:17.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

124:t_024:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ゼロ$$, what's your assessment?」

124:t_025:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Calculating from our current forces, we can sustain combat for six minutes at most.」

124:t_025:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You heard him, everyone. We'll keep fighting for six more minutes.」

124:t_025:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Even if we can't take down $$セントラル・ベース$$, it's a chance to whittle down the Empire's forces.」

124:t_025:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「For the sake of what comes next, I propose we fight as long as we possibly can.」

124:t_025:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「Understood. ...All units, you heard that!」

124:t_025:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Admirable, admirable. As expected of all of you in $c, who fought through the $$時獄戦役$$.」

124:t_025:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Maybe it's because I'm surrounded by so many quiet men... A man who talks lightly grates on me.」

124:t_025:8.en:
$$スザク$$
「Let's do this, everyone. With everything we've got...!」

124:t_025:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Six more minutes... In that time, we whittle down the enemy's forces as much as we can...!」

124:t_025:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Be very careful of the enemy $$スフィア・リアクター$$! That machine seems to be forming a special field around itself!」

124:t_025:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$スフィア・アクト$$, huh...!」

124:t_025:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It seems that power differs from Reactor to Reactor.」

124:t_025:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's do it! All units, begin the attack!」

124:t_025:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I know, I know. Let's show them six minutes of hell.」

124:t_026:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Calculating from our current forces, we can sustain combat for five minutes at most.」

124:t_026:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You heard him, everyone. We'll keep fighting for five more minutes.」
